answer: It tracks every change (insert, update, delete) in a database. [Ch. 5] Many cloud databases can trigger a function or write to a stream when there's a change. [Ch. 7]

citations.quote: is a method for extracting each change event (insert, update, delete) that occurs in a database
For instance, many cloud-hosted databases can be configured to directly trigger a serverless function or write to an event stream every time a change happens in the database.
